# Vendored front-end libraries

- `vis-network.min.js` / `vis-network.min.css` — [vis-network](https://github.com/visjs/vis-network),
  dual-licensed under Apache 2.0 and MIT. Embedded verbatim into every generated HTML file so the
  output works offline. To upgrade, replace both files with the same version from
  https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/vis-network/ and update the version below.

Version: see the header comment at the top of `vis-network.min.js`.
